svg.title: Planned Trade Maneuver integration architecture, with Proximtype as the example producer
svg.desc: Planned integration. Proximtype is an example producer and is not integrated. The local flow will use a demo analytics application. Producers publish the v1 contract through their own outboxes. Trade Maneuver records and evaluates trade signals, creates orders that await operator approval in manual execution mode, and submits approved orders to a simulated, fictional broker during trading sessions. Signal outcomes leave through its transactional outbox, and messages it cannot process go to a dead letter queue. Each service owns its database.

text.font-family: Consolas, Liberation Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace

text.tspan: One contract for multiple producers. The first iteration runs in manual execution mode.
Planned integration. Proximtype is an example producer and is not integrated. The local flow will use a demo analytics application.
